Faithful translation of the official easy_drug source restructured in KO — no new medical facts, no weakening of efficacy/contraindications/cautions, pharmacist-consultation routing preserved. Merged into config groups[fp].en. 25 groups / 100 masters. English romanized titles.

896c9f96ab4136c9.title: Senbibaek Neuro Up Tablet
896c9f96ab4136c9.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for supplementation of vitamins D, B1, B2, B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy/lactation, reduced stamina during or after illness, growth periods, and old age; prevention of poor bone and tooth development and rickets; relief of beriberi, eye fatigue, neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (lower-back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis; and supplementation of zinc.
896c9f96ab4136c9.usage:
Adolescents aged 12 and older and adults: take 1 tablet once daily.
Follow the prescribed dosage.
896c9f96ab4136c9.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: those hypersensitive to this medicine; hypercalcemia; sarcoidosis; kidney disease; kidney stones; severe renal failure; or infants under 12 months.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; premature infants, infants; gastrointestinal disorders such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional enteritis; cardiac/circulatory dysfunction; renal impairment; hypoproteinemia; or a history of kidney stones.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

Do not take with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, antacids, or levodopa. Taking with antialdosterone agents or triamterene may cause hyperkalemia, so use with caution. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after taking this medicine.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, red spots, cardiac arrest, central nervous system depression, dermatitis, body odor in sweat/breath, hair loss, restlessness, gastrointestinal disorders, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, or pulmonary edema occur, or there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins D, B-group and zinc for fatigue, recovery, growth and old age
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, rickets prevention, beriberi, neuralgia/joint pain, stomatitis

Follow the prescribed dosage.
8cd3f4345b3aa75a.caution:
Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to this medicine or an infant under 12 months.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you have gastrointestinal disorders such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional enteritis; cardiac/circulatory dysfunction; renal impairment; or hypoproteinemia. If there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

Do not take with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist when taking with antialdosterone agents or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after taking this medicine.

If nausea, vomiting, loose stools, dermatitis, body odor in sweat/breath, hair loss, restlessness, gastrointestinal disorders, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, or pulmonary edema occur, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamin B1, zinc and selenium for fatigue and recovery
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, reduced stamina, zinc/selenium supplementation

93f8f9da82d5e19d.title: Mitu-S Soft Capsule
93f8f9da82d5e19d.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for supplementation of vitamins E, B1, B2, B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy/lactation, reduced stamina during or after illness, and old age; relief of neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (lower-back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), beriberi, eye fatigue, angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis; relief of peripheral circulation disorders and menopausal shoulder/neck stiffness, numbness of hands and feet, and cold hands and feet; and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
93f8f9da82d5e19d.usage:
Ages 12 and older and adults: take 1 capsule twice daily.
Follow the prescribed dosage.
93f8f9da82d5e19d.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: those hypersensitive to this medicine or to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts; infants under 12 months; or severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; premature infants, infants; cardiac/circulatory dysfunction; renal impairment; hypoproteinemia; a lipid-metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or otherwise require caution with lipid emulsions; at special risk from lipid overload; a thrombotic (blood-vessel-blocking) predisposition; or hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or Yellow No. 5 or have such experience. If there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

When administering to children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Do not take with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist when using with estrogen-containing oral contraceptives, antialdosterone agents, triamterene, or intravenous lipid preparations. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after taking this medicine.

If nausea, vomiting, loose stools, gastric discomfort, diarrhea, constipation, redness (congested reddening), rash, red spots, cardiac arrest, central nervous system depression, or menstruation coming earlier than expected, increasing in amount, or bleeding for a prolonged period occur, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins E, B-group and relieves circulation problems and muscle cramps
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, neuralgia/joint pain, cold hands/feet, muscle cramps

94159bef193bffba.title: Liver Gold F Soft Capsule
94159bef193bffba.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for adjunctive treatment of chronic liver disease and toxic liver disease.
94159bef193bffba.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule 3 times daily. After improvement, reduce the dose to 1–2 capsules per day.
Follow the prescribed dosage.
94159bef193bffba.caution:
Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to or have experienced allergy to soybean oil, or are hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant; have hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis or other lipid-metabolism disorder, or otherwise require caution with lipid emulsions.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

When administering to children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

If diarrhea or any abnormal symptom occurs, or there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Adjunctive treatment for chronic and toxic liver disease
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Chronic liver disease, toxic liver disease

94c92b1f1f508cec.title: Theragen Vita Gold Tablet

Follow the prescribed dosage.
94c92b1f1f508cec.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: those hypersensitive to this medicine; infants under 12 months; hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood); sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause); kidney disease; kidney stones; severe renal failure; or hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; premature infants, infants; have hyperoxaluria (excess oxalate excreted in urine); cardiac/circulatory dysfunction; renal impairment; hypoproteinemia; gout; kidney stones or a history of them; a thrombotic (blood-vessel-blocking) predisposition; deficient in folic acid; or hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or have such experience. If there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of blood glucose in various urine tests and may turn urine yellow, affecting clinical test values.

Do not take with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist when taking with estrogen-containing oral contraceptives, antialdosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after taking this medicine.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, gastric discomfort, constipation, rash, redness (congested reddening), loose stools, red spots, cardiac arrest, central nervous system depression, gastrointestinal disorders, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, pulmonary edema, or menstruation coming earlier than expected, increasing in amount, or bleeding for a prolonged period occur, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins B-group, C, D, E and zinc for fatigue, recovery and growth
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, neuralgia/joint pain, stomatitis, beriberi, rickets prevention

95f26bb515556289.title: Wishingyou Tablet
95f26bb515556289.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for hyperacidity, heartburn, indigestion, gastric discomfort, gastric bloating, food stagnation, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, acid belching, overeating, promotion of digestion, and loss of appetite.
95f26bb515556289.usage:
Ages 15 and older and adults: take 2 tablets 3 times daily, 30 minutes after meals.
Follow the prescribed dosage.
95f26bb515556289.caution:
Do not take this medicine if you are a patient receiving dialysis therapy or a child aged 7 or under.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you have renal impairment, an allergic constitution, or are on a sodium-restricted diet. If there is no improvement after about 2 weeks of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

Do not take tetracycline antibiotics while taking this medicine.

If constipation or diarrhea occur, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves hyperacidity and aids digestion for indigestion-related symptoms
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Hyperacidity, heartburn, indigestion, gastric discomfort/bloating, nausea

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins B1, B6 for fatigue, recovery and nerve/muscle relief
